artworks.title: The Sparrow of Lesbie (Le moineau de Lesbie)
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of a person reclining against a stone block. The person's upper body and legs are visible. One arm rests on their head while the other is draped across their torso. The person has a contemplative expression and short hair covered by a headpiece. They wear a loose garment starting at their waist. Foliage details surround them, along with a bird perched nearby. Beneath the stone block is a small winged, cherub-like figure on the ground. The background is plain with few details.

artworks.title: Oude-Kate
artworks.description: This image features an elderly woman seated and shown from the knees up. Her body is angled slightly to the side, with one knee crossed over the other as she holds a knife in one hand while appearing to peel vegetables. Her face is detailed with deep lines, suggesting age, and she has a thoughtful expression with a focused gaze. Her hair is not visible as it is covered by a headscarf. The woman's clothing consists of a simple, long-sleeved dress with loose-fitting sleeves and a high collar. Next to her, there is a basket containing a number of round objects. The background is dark and textured, emphasizing the figure and her immediate surroundings without providing much additional detail.

artworks.title: Le Rydeack
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing near a doorway. She appears soft-faced with a subtle expression and has an intricate updo and hat. She wears a long dark dress with ruffled layers and a patterned blouse with puffy sleeves. In her right hand, she holds an apple with her ring finger extended. Beside her is a figure holding an umbrella. The background is a dimly lit, indoor space with square lamps and a large window with grid-like panes.

artworks.title: Satan Sowing Tare (Satan semant l'ivraie)
artworks.description: This print depicts a tall, elongated figure walking across a landscape beneath a dark sky. The figure wears a wide-brimmed hat, a loose, flowing garment, and clog-like shoes with pointed, upturned toes. They have long hair and limbs that are exaggeratedly long and thin. We can't see their face. They are facing the right, with one leg in front of the other as if they are mid-step. Their left hand holds a bundle of cloth to their chest, either the flowing train of their garment or some kind of bag. The shapes of small people appear to fall out of this flowing cloth towards the ground below. In their outstretched right hand, they hold two of these small people, holding them over the ground as if about to drop them. The landscape below appears to be a dark cityscape, with some rooftops and towers visible. There is also a pale river with bridges stretching across it. The sky above is shadowy, with a pale moon or sun on the right partially covered by dark clouds.

artworks.title: Evening (Le soir)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene overlooking water from an elevated angle. The horizon is high in the composition, separating water and sky. A pier extends towards the horizon, with a three-masted sailing ship in the left distance. The artwork uses Pointillist brushstrokes, creating a mosaic-like texture. The color palette includes soft pastel hues of blues, greens, and pinks, creating a serene atmosphere. Small boats with colorful sails are on the water, reflecting the same stippled technique. To the right, a large structure, possibly a lighthouse or pier, casts shadows. In the distance, ships with full sails are visible under the subtly colored sky.

artworks.title: In the Park
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people interacting in a park-like setting viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The scene is framed by tall trees and lush foliage, with figures placed at various depths. The artwork uses pointillism technique with small dots of color applied systematically to create the image. The brushstrokes form distinct patterns and offer texture. The color palette includes yellows, blues, greens, reds, and pinks, creating a warm atmosphere. Closest to us is a seated figure in light blue with another figure in a shaded cloak, both surrounded by green grass. In the distance, an orange horse is among several people dressed in Victorian-style garments under the tree shadows.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image is a black and white sketch showing a portrait of a man's upper body. He is positioned facing slightly to the right with a direct gaze towards the viewer. The man has a strong jawline, a full mustache, and beard. He has wavy hair styled upwards and wears eyeglasses. He is dressed in a suit with a bow tie, conveying formality. The background is minimal with simple line shading.

artworks.title: Calm Excursion
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene featuring a man wearing a hat sitting on grass by a water body, with his back facing us. A cane lies beside him. A duck is floating in the water nearby, along with another bird. In the background, a rowboat with two passengers paddling is visible, while a strip of trees and a classical pavilion stand out near the horizon. The etching uses fine lines and crosshatching for texture, with a monochromatic color palette of various shades of gray highlighting the serene scene and reflections in the water.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a path where a person walks a dog. The viewpoint is from above, showing the path, a person, a dog, and a distant horizon with trees and small buildings. The style uses black ink strokes on a beige background, creating texture and depth. The image has no color, giving it a classic, serene rural feel.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait II
artworks.description: The portrait shows a man with a full beard and short hair, wearing a suit with a bow tie. He is facing forward with a direct gaze. The background features line-drawn trees and a cloudy sky. There is a decorative border at the bottom with floral motifs and the signature of Hans Thoma along with the year 1898.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait VI with Flower
artworks.description: The image is a detailed drawing of an elderly man seated and facing forward from the waist up. He holds a flower in his right hand near the center of the image. The man has a full beard, a bald head, and short white hair on the sides. His eyes are deep-set and gaze directly at the viewer with a calm demeanor. He wears a high-collared jacket with visible buttons. His hand shows detailed lines and texture, and the background includes foliage or dense tree branches, providing a textured and shaded backdrop.

artworks.title: Sorrento
artworks.description: The image exhibits an elevated viewpoint over a coastal town next to the sea. There are buildings on a cliff edge in the foreground, with intricate architectural details. Further out, the town spreads across gently rolling terrain with various buildings and towers. The horizon shows distant mountains with muted peaks. The painting technique includes expressive yet detailed brushstrokes depicting rocky cliffs and soft clouds. The color scheme consists of earthy tones like browns, ochres, and blues, creating a tranquil Mediterranean ambiance against a vast sky with subtly painted clouds. The sea on the left side contrasts with the warm tones, with gentle waves reaching the shore.

artworks.title: Anna Held and Baldy (Anna Held et Baldy)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures from the waist up. The figure on the right is a female with long hair styled upwards, in conversation with the figure on the left, a male holding a top hat in his left hand. The female has her body turned slightly to the left and her head tilted upwards, while the male is slightly hunched forward facing her. Both figures have facial features and are dressed, with a blurred and dreamlike background.

artworks.title: Bust of Mademoiselle Marcelle Lender (Mademoiselle Marcelle Lender, en buste)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body in profile. She has a prominent nose, slightly arched eyebrows, closed eyes, and red lips. Her hair is styled up with red and black feathers. She wears an elaborate outfit with a high-necked garment, ruffled white collar with blue specks, patterned gray sleeves, and a textured dark blue chest adornment. There is no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background is light beige with swirling yellow patterns.

artworks.title: Last Ballad (Ultime ballade)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on China paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a figure wearing a wide-brimmed hat and draped cloak set against an abstract urban background. The image uses strong contrasts of black and white, creating a silhouetted figure at the center. The surrounding environment features architectural elements like buildings and fences, rendered in a stylized manner. The lines are bold and graphic, adding a sense of movement to the composition.

artworks.title: Your Mouth (Ta bouche)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on China paper
artworks.description: The image shows an upper half of a person's body in a reclining position, lying on their side with their head resting on one arm. The facial features are simplistic with minimal details, showing a relaxed expression and closed eyes. The person has short, dark hair. There are fluffy pillows around them, suggesting they are in bed. Next to the bed, there is a bedside table with indistinct objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Zimmerman et sa machine (Zimmerman and His Machine)
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray on velin paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bicycle with its rider. The sketch shows a figure standing beside a bicycle. The medium is pencil on paper, with a minimalistic style using simple lines and shading. The rider is dressed in a form-fitting outfit, and the bicycle's front wheel and handlebars are featured. The composition focuses more on the figure than on the details of the bicycle.

artworks.title: Spira
artworks.description: The image is a portrait capturing the person's upper body, including their head, shoulders, and one hand. The person is slightly turned to the left, with their head resting against their right hand in a fist close to their face. The facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a mustache. The hair is dark and appears wavy or curly. The individual wears a dark suit with a visible white shirt and tie. The background is a simple, dark shading that contrasts with the lighter tone of the paper. The artwork is signed by the artist at the bottom right corner of the paper.

artworks.title: Madame Simon, II
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual from the upper half of their body. The person is seated and their head is slightly turned. The face is detailed with textured features, deep-set eyes, and pronounced facial lines. The hair is dense and curly, blending into dark shading. The person is wearing a textured, voluminous cloak. The background is plain with light shading, contrasting the dark lines of the figure.

artworks.title: Edouard Manet, Bust-Length Portrait  (Manet en buste)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint in red-brown on wove paper
artworks.description: This is an etching showing a side profile of a man's upper body. The man is facing left with his head turned slightly towards the front. He has a prominent nose, a beard, and a receding hairline with his hair combed back. He is wearing a dark jacket and a white collared shirt. The background has horizontal lines, giving it a textured appearance. A signature "Degas" is at the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: The Deposition
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The drawing features a central figure on a cross, with two other figures on crosses on either side. There is a ladder leaning against the central cross. Various figures are gathered around the central cross, some appear to be reacting with mourning or attending to the scene. In the background are architectural elements, likely depicting a city or structures, as well as a grouping of trees. The style appears to be highly detailed and intricate, focusing on fine lines and shading to create depth and emotion within the scene.

artworks.title: Henry II as the Victorious Saint Michael
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in the drawing. The central figure is being crowned with a halo-like crown, dressed in classical armor and robes. The figure to the left is holding a shield with fleur-de-lis designs and a raised sword, while the figure to the right is grasping the crown. A defeated creature lies on the ground with exaggerated, monstrous features such as claws and a horned head. The background is filled with clouds, and there is a sense of movement through the flowing lines of the garments and aura surrounding the crowned figure. The scene suggests a thematic portrayal of divine justice or a celestial coronation.

artworks.title: La Majesté Royale
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures surrounded by symbolic elements. The central figure is seated on a throne, wearing a crown, and is flanked by two other figures. One figure holds a sword and a banner labeled "RENOMMEE," while the other holds a book or document. They are surrounded by clouds and cherubs, with a snake coiling at their feet. There is an empty banner below them labeled "ICONES VARIAE APOCALIPSIS." The composition features rich details, with elaborate drapery, symbolic objects, and an array of figures suggesting a narrative or allegorical theme.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures and architectural elements. The artwork includes a central figure with a sense of drama and movement, surrounded by other figures engaged in various activities. Detailed architectural elements such as columns and arches are visible in the background. The intricate line work and use of contrast suggest a high level of craftsmanship typical of drawings from the Renaissance or Baroque periods.
